questions.question: Jenkins nima? Controller va agent arxitekturasi?
questions.explanation: Self-hosted CI/CD server (Java). Controller — UI, scheduling, konfiguratsiya; agent (node) — build'ni bajaradi. Build controller'da ishlamasligi kerak.

questions.question: Freestyle job va Pipeline farqi?
questions.explanation: Freestyle — UI'da sozlanadigan oddiy job, versiyalanmaydi. Pipeline — `Jenkinsfile` (Groovy DSL), kod sifatida git'da, stage'lar, resume, review.

questions.question: Declarative Jenkinsfile tuzilmasi qanday?
questions.explanation: `pipeline { agent; environment; stages { stage { steps } }; post }`. Declarative — qat'iy sintaksis, validatsiya; Scripted — erkin Groovy.

questions.question: Jenkins'da credential qanday ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Credentials store'da saqlanadi (ID bilan), `withCredentials` yoki `environment { X = credentials('id') }` bilan step'ga beriladi, log'da maskalanadi.

questions.question: Build trigger turlari?
questions.explanation: Webhook (push/PR), Poll SCM (cron bilan git tekshirish), cron (`triggers { cron(...) }`), upstream job, qo'lda, `parameters` bilan.

questions.question: Declarative pipeline'da `agent any`, `agent none`, `label`, `docker` farqi?
questions.explanation: `any` — har qanday bo'sh agent. `none` — global agent yo'q, har stage o'zi tanlaydi. `label` — tegli agent. `docker` — agent ustida container ichida.

questions.question: Workspace nima va uni qanday tozalaysiz?
questions.explanation: Workspace — agent'dagi build katalogi (`$WORKSPACE`), job'lar orasida saqlanib qoladi. Eski fayllar keyingi build'ni buzishi mumkin — `cleanWs()` yoki `deleteDir()`.

questions.question: `options` blokida nimalar sozlanadi?
questions.explanation: `timeout`, `retry`, `buildDiscarder`, `disableConcurrentBuilds`, `timestamps`, `skipDefaultCheckout`, `durabilityHint` — pipeline yoki stage darajasida.

questions.question: `archiveArtifacts` va `junit` nima uchun ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: `archiveArtifacts` — build natijasini (binary, report) Jenkins'da saqlaydi. `junit` — test report'ni parse qilib trend va fail'larni UI'da ko'rsatadi; fail test build'ni `UNSTABLE` qiladi.

questions.question: Multibranch Pipeline va Organization Folder qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Multibranch — repo'ni skanerlaydi, `Jenkinsfile` bor har branch/PR uchun job yaratadi. Organization Folder — butun GitHub org/GitLab group'ni skanerlaydi.

questions.question: Shared Library nima va qanday versiyalanadi?
questions.explanation: Ko'p pipeline'lar uchun umumiy Groovy kod (`vars/`, `src/`, `resources/`) alohida repo'da. `@Library('lib@v1.2') _` bilan versiyaga pin qilinadi.

questions.question: `parallel` va `stash/unstash` qachon ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: `parallel` — stage'larni bir vaqtda turli agent'larda. `stash` — fayllarni bir agent'dan boshqasiga shu build ichida uzatish (kichik fayllar uchun).

questions.question: Kubernetes plugin bilan dinamik agent'lar qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Har build uchun pod yaratiladi (pod template, bir nechta container), tugagach o'chadi. Statik agent'lar o'rniga ephemeral, autoscale.

questions.question: `input` step va manual approval'ning gotcha'si?
questions.explanation: `input` pipeline'ni insonning tasdig'igacha to'xtatadi. Gotcha: agent ichida kutsa executor band qoladi — `agent none` bilan stage darajasida va `timeout` bilan ishlatish kerak.

questions.question: `when` direktivasi bilan qanday shartlar yoziladi?
questions.explanation: `branch`, `tag`, `environment`, `expression`, `changeset`, `changeRequest`, `allOf`/`anyOf`/`not`; `beforeAgent true` — agent ajratishdan oldin tekshirish.

questions.question: `lock` (Lockable Resources) va `milestone` nima uchun?
questions.explanation: `lock` — bir resursga (test DB, environment) bir vaqtda faqat bitta build. `milestone` — yangi build milestone'dan o'tsa eski build'lar bekor qilinadi (eski versiya yangisidan keyin deploy bo'lmasin).

questions.question: Jenkins'ni GitHub/GitLab bilan webhook orqali qanday ulaysiz?
questions.explanation: Repo'da webhook (`/github-webhook/` yoki GitLab plugin endpoint), Jenkins'da Multibranch + Branch Source plugin, commit status/PR check'ni qaytarish. Credential — GitHub App (token rotation, yuqori rate limit).

questions.question: `matrix` direktivasi Declarative pipeline'da qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: `matrix { axes { axis {...} } stages {...} }` — o'qlar kombinatsiyasi parallel ishlaydi; `excludes` bilan ba'zilarini olib tashlash.

questions.question: Scripted va Declarative pipeline qachon qaysi biri?
questions.explanation: Declarative — default: qat'iy struktura, validatsiya, `post`, `when`, o'qish oson. Scripted (`node {}`) — to'liq Groovy, dinamik logika; lekin murakkab va xatoga moyil. Declarative ichida `script {}` — kichik dinamik qism.

questions.question: Groovy CPS va sandbox: nega Jenkinsfile'da oddiy Groovy kutilganday ishlamaydi?
questions.explanation: Pipeline CPS (Continuation Passing Style) bilan qayta yoziladi — controller restart'dan keyin resume uchun holat serializatsiya qilinadi. Serializable bo'lmagan obyekt, closure'lar, ba'zi metodlar ishlamaydi; `@NonCPS` kerak. Sandbox xavfli metodlarni bloklaydi (script approval).

questions.question: Jenkins controller'ni production'da qanday xavfsiz va barqaror qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Controller'da executor 0, RBAC (Matrix/Role-based), SSO, plugin minimal va yangilangan, CSRF yoqilgan, agent > controller security, JCasC bilan konfiguratsiya kodda, `JENKINS_HOME` backup.

questions.question: Jenkins sekin va beqaror bo'lsa — qanday debug qilasiz?
questions.explanation: O'lcha: queue va build vaqtlari, controller heap/GC, thread dump, disk (`JENKINS_HOME`, build history). Odatiy sabablar: ko'p build tarixi, og'ir Groovy controller'da, plugin leak, stash katta fayl.

questions.question: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI — qachon qaysi birini tanlaysiz?
questions.explanation: Kod qayerda bo'lsa o'sha platformaning CI'si default (Actions/GitLab). Jenkins — on-prem, murakkab legacy integratsiyalar, maxsus agent talablari bo'lsa; narxi — operatsion yuk.

questions.question: Jenkins'da build reproducibility va supply chain xavfsizligini qanday ta'minlaysiz?
questions.explanation: Agent image'lari immutable va pin qilingan, dependency mirror (Nexus/Artifactory), artifact imzolash (cosign) va SBOM, build'ni tag/SHA'dan, credential'lar qisqa muddatli (Vault), Jenkinsfile o'zgarishi review'dan.

questions.question: JCasC (Configuration as Code) va Job DSL bilan Jenkins'ni qanday kod sifatida boshqarasiz?
questions.explanation: JCasC — global konfiguratsiya (security realm, credentials, agent cloud, plugin sozlamalari) YAML'da. Job DSL / Organization Folder — job'lar kodda. Plugin'lar `plugins.txt` bilan pin, controller immutable image.

questions.question: Jenkins'dan GitHub Actions/GitLab CI'ga migratsiyani qanday rejalashtirasiz?
questions.explanation: Inventarizatsiya (job'lar, plugin'lar, credential'lar, trigger'lar) > logikani Jenkins'dan mustaqil skriptlarga chiqarish > pilot repo > parallel ishlatish (shadow) > bosqichma-bosqich ko'chirish > Jenkins'ni read-only, keyin o'chirish.

questions.question: Jenkins'da agent'lar orasida build cache'ni qanday hal qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Ephemeral agent'da cache yo'q. Variantlar: PVC (K8s, ReadWriteMany yoki har node uchun), remote cache (Gradle/Bazel remote cache, Go `GOCACHE` S3 sync), dependency proxy (Nexus), pre-baked agent image.

questions.question: Ko'p jamoali Jenkins'da RBAC va multi-tenancy qanday tashkil qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Folder'lar har jamoa uchun, Role-based Authorization Strategy (folder/item role), folder-scope credential, alohida agent label'lar, SSO group mapping. Kuchli izolyatsiya kerak bo'lsa — alohida controller'lar.

questions.question: Jenkins pipeline'da deployment strategiyasi (blue-green, canary, rollback) qanday quriladi?
questions.explanation: Jenkins orkestrator: build bir marta, artifact'ni staging'ga, smoke test, approval, prod'ga canary (masalan Argo Rollouts/Helm), metrika tekshiruvi, avtomatik rollback. Jenkins o'zi traffic boshqarmaydi.

questions.question: Jenkins plugin'larini qanday boshqarasiz va yangilaysiz?
questions.explanation: Minimal plugin to'plami, `plugins.txt` da versiya pin, Plugin Installation Manager CLI bilan image'ga o'rnatish, staging controller'da test, keyin prod. Security advisory'larni kuzatish.
